SleepTimeAfterActionCompleted_s.blurb: Wait (s) after gaze-direction reaction turns/anims before finishing the compound action — not SleepCycle; Vision.GazeDirection / ReactToGazeDirection.

SleepCycle_DeepSleep_PersonCheckInterval.blurb: Interval (s) between person-check wake opportunities while in DeepSleep (default 4 h).

SleepCycle_LightSleep_PersonCheckInterva.blurb: Interval (s) between person-check wake opportunities while in LightSleep (default 0.5 h).

SleepCycle_ComatoseLength_s.blurb: How long (s) Comatose lasts after system_sleep before transitioning to DeepSleep (default 30 s).

SleepCycle_RecentSleepLength_s.blurb: Min time awake after natural wake (s) before sleepy natural sleep can re-trigger (default 10 min).

SleepCycle_MinSleepDebt_s.blurb: Minimum sleep debt (s) enforced when entering light/deep sleep so natural wake is not immediate (default 30 min).

SleepCycle_EnableWiggleWhileSleeping.blurb: If false, disables wiggle-back-onto-charger while sleeping when contacts are lost.

SleepCycleForceSleep.blurb: When true, GoToSleepIfNeeded immediately enters light/deep sleep (console force; DAS SleepReason::ConsoleVar).
SleepCycleForceSleep.statusNote: Forces freeplay into sleep path every check while true — use only for debug.

SleepCycleForceLightSleep.blurb: When true, TransitionToLightOrDeepSleep always chooses LightSleep even at night (skips DeepSleep).

SleepCycle_TooLongOnChargerNotChargingDu.blurb: If battery disconnected-duration while “charging” exceeds this (s) during ObservingOnCharger, force sleep (overheat cooldown).

SleepingStirSpacing_min_s.blurb: Min wait (s) between sleep bouts before next stir bout in BehaviorSleeping (default 2700).

SleepingStirSpacing_max_s.blurb: Max wait (s) between sleep bouts before next stir bout (default 5400).

SleepingBoutSpacing_min_s.blurb: Min wait (s) between individual stir animations within a bout (default 1.5).

SleepingBoutSpacing_max_s.blurb: Max wait (s) between stirs in a bout (default 5).

SleepingBoutNumStirs_min.blurb: Min number of stir animations per bout (default 5).

SleepingBoutNumStirs_max.blurb: Max number of stir animations per bout (default 10).

SleepTracker_moning_hour.blurb: Local-time morning hour (0–23) that ends “night” for IsNightTime (typo moning is source name). Default 7.

SleepTracker_moning_minute.blurb: Local-time morning minute (0–59) with moning_hour; default 0.

SleepTracker_night_hour.blurb: Local-time night hour (0–23) that starts “night”; must be after morning and before midnight. Default 21.

SleepTracker_night_minute.blurb: Local-time night minute (0–59) with night_hour; default 0.

SleepTracker_awakeSleepDebtRate.blurb: Debt accumulation multiplier while awake: each update adds period_s * this rate (default 20/4 = 5×).

SleepTracker_maxSleepDebt_hours.blurb: Cap on sleep debt in hours (default 20); clamp after each debt update.

SleepTracker_debtToConsiderSleepy_awake.blurb: Sleep debt (s) threshold for IsSleepy(fromSleep=false) while awake (default 3600).

SleepTracker_debtToConsiderSleepy_fromSl.blurb: Sleep debt (s) threshold for IsSleepy while already asleep / fromSleep path (default 1800); also floor warning in EnsureSleepDebtAtLeast.

SleepTracker_updatePeriod_s.blurb: How often (s) sleep debt is stepped and WebViz sleeping payload refreshed (default 60).
